verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs claim serverless functions, automatic HTTPS/DDoS protection, and edge deployment (netlify-docs-6, netlify-docs-9) implying elastic scaling, but there's no explicit evidence of sub-second boot times or tested tens-of-thousands scale. Community reports directly contradict reliable large-scale handling, describing massive surprise bills and DDoS-related cost blowups reaching $104k, with Netlify's stance being 'if you're hosting a small site that gets DDoS'd, don't' (netlify-comm-1, netlify-comm-2, netlify-comm-15).
